authority: Explicit user Part B authorization; approved_ticket.md controls allocation. Design is background, not extra execution authority.
reliability_scope: Six simultaneous one-sided95% upper bounds. Lower bounds are a separately controlled six-comparison one-sided95% family; do not call combined interval simultaneous95% two-sided. No added superiority test.

latency_bootstrap.kind: paired circular moving block per SNR in actual frame order
latency_bootstrap.scope: pointwise bootstrap uncertainty, not familywise; whole paired frames resampled; all finite attempt costs retained
latency_bootstrap.block_rule: min(32,max(1,registered_paired_frame_count//8)); fixed by prospective subset size, not outcomes. Primary block32, POINT16, PBi4. Avoid full-sample circular blocks producing degenerate control intervals.

deadline_reference: Frozen E1 D EP2 complete-time median of all32 frames per cell on same machine, value/hash locked before production
deadline_rule: last valid completed decoder checkpoint ready<=deadline; no timely decision is frame failure; never use future checkpoint
failure_rule: numerical failure retains paid time and latest valid completed checkpoint; missing decision is FER failure, unavailable BER bits remain missing; all anomalies explicit. Integrity/qualification/source/leak/unfair-cost defect stops science for report without silent repair/resume.

decision.supported: All six excess-FER upper bounds<=tolerance AND all three TF/EP2 median-ratio one-sided95% upper bounds<0.8 AND all three observed TF/EP2 p90 ratios<=1; integrity/recount complete. EP4 full results remain disclosed.
decision.falsified: Any separately controlled lower excess-FER bound>tolerance OR TF/EP2 one-sided95% lower median-ratio bound>=0.8 OR one-sided95% lower p90-ratio bound>1 in any primary cell. Integrity defect is blocked, not scientific falsification.
decision.inconclusive: Complete validated allocation with neither supported nor falsified condition. Point estimates and failed pass criteria retained; no allocation extension.

retention: Per-frame seeds/config/source hashes; actual checkpoint bits,input/APP/check,paths/scalar traces/stages. Heavy vector subset frame0/cell and numerical exceptions only. No outcome-dependent collection on ordinary decode errors.
primary_error_unit: information-frame error (any wrong information bit); missing decision counts failure. Codeword-frame errors and both BER counts reported separately.
checkpoint_validity: completed numerical decoder output with validated binary shape/accounting. Do not require zero syndrome or use truth to choose checkpoint; select latest available completion.
